title: Career Development and Counselling Across the Lifespan
description: Lifespan and career development as a dynamic and holistic enterprise. Theories and techniques of career development, assessment, and consultation are explored. The practice of career counselling for diverse populations including work-related issues.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CNPY 516, ED-D 519H, ED-D 591 (if taken in the same topic).
Students who have counselling or related background may request permission to register in the course.

The majority of seats in this course are reserved for students in the counselling psychology graduate program. Enrolment for students outside of the counselling psychology graduate program is limited.
